name: Greater Mark Of Shadow
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Shadow Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Improved Intuition
features.description: When you use the Cunning Intuition benefit of your Mark of Shadow feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

features.name: Improved Shadow
features.description: When you use the Shape Shadows benefit of your Mark of Shadow feat to cast Invisibility without a spell slot, you cast the spell as its level 3 version.
